seo_desc: Trapped in AWS or Azure? We design cloud-agnostic B2B infrastructures with Kubernetes to migrate between clouds and avoid abusive price hikes.
author_pitch: As a Cloud Specialist, I see big tech companies hijacking their B2B clients every day. When your infrastructure relies 100% on native services from a single provider, you are at the mercy of their pricing. My goal is to give you back control by designing agnostic architectures that allow you to switch clouds in minutes without rewriting a single line of code.
title: The server hijacking: Cloud-Agnostic Architecture to escape Vendor Lock-in
body:
Has your cloud provider just raised their rates by 30% and you cannot leave because your software is completely anchored to their ecosystem?

The greatest risk for a B2B company today is not technology; it is technological kidnapping (Vendor Lock-in). When you build your software using exclusively the native and proprietary services of a single giant (like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), you sign a pact of absolute dependency. If tomorrow they decide to double the cost of their database or deprecate a critical API, your company will have to pay the bill without complaining. Migrating to a cheaper cloud would cost you months of work and hundreds of thousands of dollars to rewrite the core logic of your application, paralyzing your growth.

The trap of Easy Native Services

Cloud providers offer you preconfigured tools that are free or very cheap at first so that you couple your code to them, making your exit technically unfeasible. Building your platform on the proprietary foundations of a third party is like building your company's factory on rented land where you do not control the lease.

Our solution: Cloud-Agnostic Infrastructure and Containers

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we give you back your data sovereignty. We design architectures based on open-source technologies and portable containers that run identically on any provider, giving you the technical and financial freedom to choose or combine the clouds that best suit you.

  1. Universal Containerization (Docker): We encapsulate your application's code, its dependencies, and configurations into standardized containers that work exactly the same on AWS, Azure, or a private server.
  2. Multi-Cloud Orchestration (Kubernetes): We deploy Kubernetes clusters to automatically manage your services, allowing you to move workloads from one provider to another in a matter of minutes.
  3. Portable Databases: We migrate your data from closed and proprietary databases to high-performance open-source engines (like PostgreSQL) hosted on neutral instances, preventing information lock-in.
  4. Infrastructure Automation (Terraform): We code your entire infrastructure as code (IaC), allowing you to destroy your environment in an expensive cloud and recreate it identically in a cheaper cloud at the push of a button.

The Real Impact on your Technology Strategy

  • Financial Negotiation Freedom: By having the technical ability to leave whenever you want, you can force cloud providers to match offers and drastically reduce your operational costs.
  • Data Sovereignty Compliance: You can host specific modules of your application on local European providers to comply with the strictest corporate data protection regulations.
  • Absolute Business Continuity: If an entire region of your main cloud suffers a global outage, you can immediately redirect your operations to a preconfigured secondary provider.
